source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

support.quote: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash in, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose so your carry's hits on the Thorns target deal bonus true damage. Once Stonewall lands, stand in front and drop Queen's Garden on their engage.
support.issue: credits Iron Rose for Thorns; Thorns come from the passive on any hero damage
support.rewrite: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash in, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose to soak damage; every hit you land marks them with Thorns, so your carry's hits on them deal bonus true damage. Once Stonewall lands, stand in front and drop Queen's Garden on their engage.

jungle.quote: Gank from an angle with Imperial Lash so the root and dash land together, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose to stick on them. With Alternator and Mutilator done by minute 16, use Queen's Garden to trap a squishy target for your team.
jungle.issue: Iron Rose does not help you stick to a target; it gives damage reduction and a vine that snaps if they run
jungle.rewrite: Gank from an angle with Imperial Lash so the root and dash land together, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and Iron Rose to take less damage while the vine ticks. With Alternator and Mutilator done by minute 16, use Queen's Garden to trap a squishy target for your team.

offlane.quote: Leap in with Skull Crusher to shred armor, then Cursed Edge so the third slash stuns, and Dire Howl to heal back what you took. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, finish a squishy target with Kingslayer.
offlane.issue: overstates Dire Howl; it heals back only part of the damage taken
offlane.rewrite: Leap in with Skull Crusher to shred armor, then Cursed Edge so the third slash stuns, and Dire Howl to heal back part of the damage you took. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, finish a squishy target with Kingslayer.

offlane.quote: Greystone, Steel, Grux and Aurora win this lane on our read; farm safely, keep Invigorate for their engage, and let your jungler start fights.
offlane.issue: names Aurora as winning the lane, but Aurora is an even matchup
offlane.rewrite: Greystone, Steel and Grux win this lane on our read, and Aurora is even; farm safely, keep Invigorate for their engage, and let your jungler start fights.

offlane.quote: Mark the bruiser, Hive to slow them, then poke with Fetid Dagger to keep Pestilence ticking while Mark heals you back. Once Spirit Of Amir is done, step into fights with Swarm and land Curse on the marked target.
offlane.issue: implies Mark heals you while you poke; only Mark's own hits heal
offlane.rewrite: Mark the bruiser to damage them and heal yourself, Hive to slow them, then poke with Fetid Dagger to keep Pestilence ticking. Once Spirit Of Amir is done, step into fights with Swarm and land Curse on the marked target.

support.quote: Mark the enemy carry so your damage heals you, Hive whoever dives your carry, and keep Fetid Dagger hitting to refresh Pestilence. As Lifecore and Noxia finish, save Curse to finish the marked target your carry is fighting.
support.issue: Mark does not make all your damage heal you; only Mark's own hits heal
support.rewrite: Use Mark on the enemy carry to damage them and heal yourself, Hive whoever dives your carry, and keep Fetid Dagger hitting to refresh Pestilence. As Lifecore and Noxia finish, save Curse to finish the marked target your carry is fighting.

offlane.quote: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Grux and Aurora all win this lane, so farm safely and save Thunk to stop their all-in until help arrives.
offlane.issue: says "all" but omits Crunch, who also wins this lane on our read
offlane.rewrite: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our read, so farm safely and save Thunk to stop their all-in until help arrives.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Phase win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and protect your carry until your jungler arrives.
support.issue: Phase is not in this lane's matchup list; Narbash is the listed third losing matchup
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and protect your carry until your jungler arrives.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn, Adele and Phase all win this lane, so stop trading and play behind your carry until your jungler comes.

support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn, Adele and Narbash all win this lane, so stop trading and play behind your carry until your jungler comes.
